Ministers Blame Previous BRS Government for Kaleshwaram Project Issues

Telangana ministers have alleged that retired engineers supported the previous BRS government in the Kaleshwaram project controversy. They are blaming the BRS party for the project's structural failures. This comes amid ongoing scrutiny of the multi-purpose irrigation project.
